scope: Read-only attribution of closed historical campaign, not validation of the current candidate or model superiority
limits: Model verification request time is bounded by returned batch availableAt, not an observed completed verification receipt.
Stage accounting is arithmetic over post-execution scorer-only physical operations; no controller consumes these fields.
No per-request completed-receipt/local-draft/local-owner-review timestamps in the historical artifact; absent stages are null, not inferred.
Within each world a single physical load served each need; first useful and sufficient are equal here, not a universal property.
Different later source hashes cannot be compared as matched interventions.
Observed fleet consequences are not a unique causal counterfactual: controlled common-allocator replay is needed.

mechanisms.hypothesis: Early inquiry gains are absorbed by finite clarification/received-capacity/owner-review queues; asynchronous material-driven planning must remain independent of source/model batch completion.
mechanisms.test: Matched same corpus and shared async review/continuation implementation for all arms; passive received timestamps and no delay-to-baseline change.

mechanisms.hypothesis: Per-batch greedy irreversible dispatch differs when received demand arrives earlier; pickup position and later truck availability can defeat earlier knowledge.
mechanisms.test: Shared bounded rolling received-demand assignment, preserving approved priority/deadlines/stock/owners; compare same received snapshots, then whole matched worlds. Do not attribute a common solver change to GenAI.

mechanisms.hypothesis: The benchmark turns text into a building-level query returning complete demand, making detailed semantic quantities irrelevant; the real product needs grounded contextual constraints/capacities to change an executable inquiry or repair.
mechanisms.test: Predeclared context/road/cargo/permission family with equal entities/raw sources/tools/finite query slots and competent B5/B8/B9; structured-facts and no-feasible-route controls, same cargo preserved.
